controls.name: edges-among-answered

controls.replace: pub open spec fn lists_edge(r: St, adj: spec_fn(int) -> Seq<int>, e: (int, int)) -> bool { r.seen.contains(e.0) && r.seen.contains(e.1) && adj(e.0).contains(e.1) }
controls.classification: decision (the repair of bug-plt-113's edge loss and bug-plt-114): the answer lists every edge between two answered nodes, so edges leaving later frontier nodes appear; the uncapped neighbor still verifies

controls.name: seeds-capped

controls.replace: let st1 = if has_edge(s) && !st.seen.contains(s) && st.count < cap { St { seen: st.seen.insert(s), count: st.count + 1, ..st } } else { st };
controls.classification: decision (the repair of bug-plt-113's seeds over the cap): a seed is admitted only while the count is below the cap; the top-3 witness and the uncapped neighbor still verify

controls.name: expand-whole-frontier-at-cap

controls.replace: if r.1 { r.0 } else { expand_frontier(frontier.drop_first(), adj, r.0, cap) }
controls.classification: effect: the frontier loop goes on to later nodes after a node leaves the count at the cap (edges to seen nodes recorded); the per-node cap test still stops at an unseen neighbor

controls.name: guided-cap-top-k-only
